body:
**RAV-RUN3-R1-F003 [low] CLI help** — CLI help says `--input-json` is offline, but `--registry-live` remains an explicit network exception that the help text does not name.

The corrected help text names that exception while retaining the offline description for `--input-json`.

**RAV-RUN3-R1-F004 [low] registry reporting** — The CLI prints registry status before live lookups, so the initial zero-count line does not show the actual query and error totals.

One final status line before publication checks replaces the initial zero-count line and shows the actual query and error totals.

**RAV-RUN3-R1-F005 [low] CLI** — CLI `--limit` handling makes `--limit 0` process all models and applies Python negative slicing to negative limits.

The corrected path rejects negative limits and runs slicing whenever the value is not `None`.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F002 [low] CLI help** — Top-level `every_eval_ever validate` help still says directory arguments are unsupported, so it omits recursive directory expansion.

The corrected help text describes recursive directory expansion for directory arguments.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F003 [low] documentation** — The documentation issue is still present: parent depth is unchecked only when the collection leaf also passes validation.

The corrected documentation states this validation boundary explicitly.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F003 [low] deployment metadata** — Supported logs normally publish `deployment_type` and `model_availability` as `unknown`, with no CLI override for known facts.

Validated CLI overrides follow the existing platform and engine override pattern.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F010 [low] test coverage** — Test coverage lacks an end-to-end publication assertion through the real CLI for strict output parsing.

The existing thorough synthetic fixture drives one CLI publication test that strictly parses and validates each emitted file.
